# Sierra Stone South & Central Okanagan

> Sierra Stone South & Central Okanagan installs natural stone aggregate coatings over existing concrete, wood, and vinyl — pool decks, patios, driveways, front steps, and indoor floors. Real stone bonded with industrial-grade epoxy and a UV-stable topcoat. 20-25+ year lifespan through Okanagan freeze-thaw and summer UV. Serving Kelowna, West Kelowna, Penticton, Vernon, Lake Country, Summerland, and Peachland.

- Phone: (250) 808-9425
- Email: info@sierrastonesouthcentral.com
- Service area: South and Central Okanagan, British Columbia, Canada
- Site: https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com

## Services

- [Pool Deck Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/pool-decks): Slip-resistant, UV-stable pool deck resurfacing.
- [Patio & Deck Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/patios-and-decks): Natural stone finish over concrete, wood, or vinyl.
- [Driveway Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/driveways): Vehicle-rated, salt and freeze-thaw resistant.
- [Front Steps & Walkway Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/front-steps): Slip-resistant textured aggregate for entries.
- [Epoxy Flooring & Indoor Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/epoxy-flooring): Garage, basement, and commercial interior floors.
- [Concrete Repair & Resurfacing](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/concrete-repair): Cosmetic concrete repair — half the cost of replacement.

## Cities Served

- [Kelowna](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/kelowna): Lower Mission, Glenmore, Rutland, Kettle Valley, Dilworth.
- [West Kelowna](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/west-kelowna): Lakeview Heights, Westbank, Glenrosa, Shannon Lake.
- [Penticton](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/penticton): Skaha, Upper Bench, Wiltse, Naramata Bench.
- [Vernon](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/vernon): Coldstream, Predator Ridge, BX, Okanagan Landing.
- [Lake Country](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/lake-country): Winfield, Oyama, Okanagan Centre.
- [Summerland](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/summerland): Trout Creek, Prairie Valley.
- [Peachland](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/peachland): Trepanier, Antlers Beach.
